title: The relative GAGA Theorem and an application to the analytic mapping stacks
summary: We prove a relative GAGA theorem for perfect and pseudo-coherent complexes in non-archimedean analytic geometry, allowing bases given by Fredholm analytic rings, including those associated from affinoid perfectoid spaces. This answers a question raised in \cite{heuer2024padicnonabelianhodgetheory}. As an application, we show that for a proper scheme \(X\) and an Artin stack \(Y\) with suitable conditions, the analytification of the algebraic mapping stack \(\mathrm{Map}(X,Y)\) agrees with the intrinsic analytic mapping stack \(\mathrm{Map}(X^{\mathrm{an}},Y^{\mathrm{an}})\).
